title: Glass Shelf with Towel Bar 16-Inch Wall Mount Tempered Glass & Solid Brass, Waverly Place Allied Brass
description:
Add wall-mounted storage and towel hanging in one with this 16-inch glass shelf with an integrated towel bar. Built with 3/8-inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass and solid brass hardware for an enduring, coordinated bath upgrade.

Highlights:
- Integrated towel bar keeps hand towels close while adding shelf storage
- Tempered glass shelf (3/8-inch thick) for safety and strength
- Solid brass hardware with a designer finish for corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- Part of the Waverly Place Collection for matching Waverly Place accessories
- Works well with transitional bath accessories, transitional bathroom hardware, and versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Projection: 5 inches
- Mounting: wall mount
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (#8 x 1 1/4 screws)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: multiple designer finishes available, including statement colors
